summary: Damodar Valley Corporation Through its Authorized Representative DVC Headquarters, DVC Towers, VIP Road, Kolkata-700054 ** Petitioner** The present Petition has been filed by DVC (“Petitioner/DVC”) under Regulation 9 (4) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 ("Tariff Regulations 2024”) seeking condonation of delay of Twenty Four (24) months in declaring commercial operation date of tubed coal mines limited and approval of input price of coal supplied from tubed open cast coal mine for the period from date of commercial operation i.e., 01.04.2024 to 31.03.2029. delayed due to various reasons, including force majeure events beyond the control of the Petitioner. 11. During the first hearing on 26.11.2024, the Commission, after hearing the parties, admitted the Petition and directed the Petitioner to issue notice to the Respondents. During the hearing on 30.7.2025, at the request of BSES Discoms for a time extension to file their Reply, the hearing of the Petition was adjourned. On 17.10.2025, after hearing the parties and at the request of the learned counsel of the Petitioner for the grant of an interim tariff, the Commission directed the Petitioner to submit certain additional information. On 17.4.2026, after hearing the parties, the Commission directed the Petitioner to submit certain additional information and the Respondents to complete the pleadings. Subject to that, the matter in the Order was reserved with regard to the Petitioner's prayer for the grant of an interim tariff for a Tubed Open Cast integrated coal mine, in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 12. The case was heard through a virtual hearing. During the hearing on ‘admission,’ the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the present petition has been filed seeking condonation of the time overrun of twenty-four (24) months in the declaration of the commercial operation date of the tubed coal mines and for approval of input price of coal supplied from tubed open cast coal mine for the period from the date of commercial operation, i.e.,1.4.2024 till 31.3.2029. The Commission, after hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, admitted the Petition and directed that notice be issued to the Respondents. The Petitioner was also directed to file certain additional information, and the Respondents are permitted to file their Replies to the Petition, along with replies on the above additional information submitted by the Petitioner, after serving a copy on the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any. 13. At the outset, the learned counsel for the Respondent, BSES Discoms, sought 3 weeks’ time to file their reply to the additional information furnished by the Petitioner. Accordingly, the hearing of the Petition was adjourned. The Petitioner is directed to file certain additional information after serving a copy on the Respondents. The Respondents are permitted to file their replies after serving a copy on the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any. 14. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that a reply and rejoinder have been filed and requested the grant of an interim tariff. The learned counsel for the Respondent submitted that there are certain information gaps that the Petitioner must address. In rebuttal, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that ROP compliance has been made by referring to the pleadings. After hearing the parties, the Commission directed the Petitioner to submit certain additional information. The Respondents are permitted to file their replies on ‘merit’, if not filed earlier, after serving a copy on the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any. 15. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the reply and rejoinder have been filed and requested the grant of an interim tariff. He further submitted that a copy of the Income Tax Return, in support of the tax rate claimed for the purpose of grossing up the Return on Equity (RoE), has been submitted in a sealed cover and requested that an order be reserved in the matter. The learned senior counsel for BRPL and BYPL submitted that they have already filed a preliminary reply in the matter and do not wish to file any further reply. After hearing the parties, the Commission directed the Petitioner to submit certain additional information and the Respondents to complete the pleading. Subject to the above, the Order in the matter was reserved with regard to the Petitioner's prayer for the grant of an interim tariff for the Tubed Open Cast integrated coal mine, in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. _“Provided that the generating company may request an interim input price in its petition, which may be allowed by the Commission up to 90% of the claimed input price after the first hearing of the application:”_ 18. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner for the grant of an interim tariff for the input price of coal supplied from the Tubed Open Cast integrated coal mine. In order to enable the Petitioner to meet its ongoing financial obligations through a reasonable recovery of the cost of mining by the Petitioner from the Respondents, and keeping in view that the interim tariff of the integrated coal mine will be subject to adjustment based on the final tariff to be determined by the Commission. We, on a prudence check, proceed to examine the Petitioner's prayer for the grant of interim tariff in the instant Petition, as stated in the subsequent paragraphs. 26. Accordingly, Petition No. 265/MP/2024 shall be listed for hearing in due course, for which a separate notice will be issued to the parties.
title: Petition under section 62 and 79(1) (a) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 22 and Regulation 9 (4) of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 seeking condonation of delay of Twenty-Four (24) months in declaring commercial operation date of tubed coal mines limited and approval of input price of coal supplied from tubed open cast coal mine for the period from date of commercial operation i.e., 01.04.2024 to 31.03.2029.
